pretreatments.description: Electrohydrolysis pretreatment using a DC power generator with graphite electrodes (cathode and anode) immersed in a pulp and paper mill sludge (PPMS) slurry (1:3 ratio of PPMS to distilled water), featuring a flash mixer rotating at 300 rpm, applying voltages up to 15 V for durations up to 45 min.
Mechanical mixing/homogenization using an insulated flash mixer rotating at 300 rpm to maintain the PPMS in suspension during the pretreatment process.
